title: mirror_paths.json (canonical-paths registry)
description: Schema for the file at <governance>/schemas/mirror_paths.json that lists files which must be byte-identical across supervised repos. See docs/concepts/mirror-cascade.md.

canonical_paths.description: Paths (relative to repo root) that must match byte-for-byte between the governance repo and every supervised repo, unless excepted.

exceptions.description: Per-adopter exceptions. Keys are adopter repo names (without owner prefix); values are canonical paths that adopter may diverge on.
